# META-INSIGHTS — about the optimization PROCESS itself (this run)

Not about the capability — about HOW this run is searching for it: which strategies/edit classes/algorithms are helping vs stalling, and what to try next iteration. Update at the end of the run at minimum; sooner if a plateau or a clear strategy shift is worth recording now. Structure each addition as:

    ## Iteration <id> (or 'run so far')
    - Strategy tried, and whether it moved val (cite LEDGER rows):
    - Plateau/stall signal, if any, and the lever switched to:
    - What to try next iteration:

## Iteration cand_0002
- Strategy: parallel read-only diagnosis subagents with access to the golden workbooks (local data cache under ~/.cache/capevolve-ci/spreadsheetbench-data). This pinned the exact mismatch per task and was far more reliable than the grader feedback text.
- Biggest finding: the prompt's own code template caused 3 zero-scores (inputs read from the formula-mode workbook). Audit templates the agent copies verbatim before adding rules.
- Next: if accepted, look at the remaining tasks individually; if rejected, split the template edit from the prompt rules.
